issues.where: data/public/calls/v2-aei-oriented-cultural-care/call.md §2: “Banda tipo A | 30.000–75.000”, “Banda tipo B | 50.000–99.000”, “Elegir 36 o 48 meses; 48 obligatorios si hay campañas oceanográficas”; call.yaml eligibility: min_budget: 30000, max_budget: 99000, duration_months_min: 36, duration_months_max: 48.
issues.problem: The hidden key retains only the outer envelope. It never states either type-specific budget band, the discrete duration choices, or the oceanographic condition. A type-A EUR 90,000 request, type-B EUR 40,000 request, or 42-month project satisfies that envelope but violates the visible rules. This remains unfixed after earlier reviews; correcting the old zero maxima did not encode the actual conditions.
issues.fix: Keep the outer bounds, but append this exact text to the existing eligibility.consortium.notes field in call.yaml: “Condiciones adicionales de esta convocatoria ficticia: costes directos tipo A, 30.000–75.000 EUR; tipo B, 50.000–99.000 EUR. Duraciones admisibles exclusivamente 36 o 48 meses; 48 meses obligatorios con campañas oceanográficas. Una o dos personas IP.” This supplies the missing conditions without requiring an unsupported schema field. These conditions must be considered together with the numeric envelope when judging compliance.

issues.where: data/public/calls/v2-aei-oriented-cultural-care/call.md §2: “El tipo B requiere una trayectoria consolidada y los requisitos generales del artículo 8.2; no aplica la ventana del tipo A. Se exige doctorado”.
issues.problem: The reference to article 8.2 imports a first-doctorate cutoff that the prose does not spell out: PID2025 requires the first doctorate before 1 January 2024 for type B too. There is no lower-date boundary for B, but it is not completely date-unrestricted. The named applicants are unaffected.
issues.fix: After “Se exige doctorado”, insert “obtenido antes del 1 de enero de 2024 (primer doctorado), también para tipo B”. Retain the stated technological-centre exception and the explicit frozen-2025 convention.
